question: Using the sales data, what is the median value of total sales made in countries where the number of customers is greater than 4?
sql:
-- Median of per-country total sales for countries with >4 customers
WITH country_sales AS (
    SELECT c.Country, SUM(i.Total) as country_total_sales
    FROM customers c
    JOIN invoices i ON c.CustomerId = i.CustomerId
    WHERE c.Country IN (
        SELECT c2.Country
        FROM customers c2
        GROUP BY c2.Country
        HAVING COUNT(*) > 4
    )
    GROUP BY c.Country
)
SELECT MEDIAN(country_total_sales) as median_total_sales
FROM country_sales
